subline: Your saved plans added together: what they use, what they score and when they finish.

plans.title: Plans in this overview
plans.hint: Only saved plans appear here. Turn a plan off to hide it everywhere on this page: the totals, the resources, the points and the full plan. Save a plan on its own page to add it.

resources.description: What all included plans take from your stock together. Meat, Wood, Coal and Iron count your backpack packs and Custom Resource Chests.
resources.generalNote: General speedups are shared by the share each plan sets. Each plan checks its own speedups on its page.

points.title: Points and power
points.description: What each plan can score in the four core events, on the day of each event that scores the most. Power is the estimate each plan shows.
points.unknownPower: The power total leaves out plans with an unknown power.

fullPlan.title: Full plan
fullPlan.description: Every goal in the included plans. The queues run side by side, so the longest one sets the finish.
fullPlan.finishes: Finishes in {time} with no extra speedups

empty.title: No saved plans yet
empty.description: Set goals on a page and save its plan. Every saved plan appears here.

allOff.title: Every plan is turned off
allOff.description: Turn a plan back on above to see its totals.
